properties.disclaimer_en: Concept-suggestion layer. Not an official redline, statutory control, surveyed existing condition or engineering conclusion; recalculate in full once official boundary and ownership data are released.
properties.name_zh: 一期：公共底板与资料回填
properties.name_en: Phase 1: public ground plane and data backfill
properties.phase_trigger_zh: 正式边界、权属、消防、道路和水务资料进入
properties.phase_trigger_en: official boundary, ownership, fire, road and water data received
properties.design_note_zh: 先建公共底板与门户四件套，不动产权复杂地块。
properties.design_note_en: Build the public ground plane and gate kit first; leave ownership-complex parcels untouched.

properties.name_zh: 二期：社区共享与场景验证
properties.name_en: Phase 2: community sharing and scenario validation
properties.phase_trigger_zh: 一期公众复盘通过且无障碍连续性达标
properties.phase_trigger_en: phase 1 public review passed and accessibility continuity met
properties.design_note_zh: 在社区段铺开共享服务与可审计场景，保留普通路径。
properties.design_note_en: Roll out shared services and auditable scenarios in the community segment while retaining ordinary routes.

properties.name_zh: 三期：产业规模化与退出准备
properties.name_en: Phase 3: industrial scaling and retirement readiness
properties.phase_trigger_zh: 二期误报基线公开且申诉闭环率达标
properties.phase_trigger_en: phase 2 false-positive baseline published and appeal closure rate met
properties.design_note_zh: 产业段规模化部署，同时预置撤除准备金与退出记录。
properties.design_note_en: Scale deployment in the industrial segment while pre-funding removal reserves and exit records.

crs_note: WGS84 lon/lat; lengths and areas recomputed in a local planar approximation.
envelope_note_zh: 分期要素是矩形外包络，用于表达时序覆盖范围，不是分期用地面积；三期外包络之和大于总用地面积属正常，请勿相加作为面积结论。
envelope_note_en: Phase features are rectangular envelopes expressing temporal coverage, not phase land areas. The three envelopes legitimately sum to more than the site area and must never be added into an area conclusion.
